title: The tech lead's choice of the stack, after discovery

decided.description: False when the brief does not yet say enough (who uses it, on what devices, what it may cost) to choose.

reason.description: Why this stack, in one or two sentences; or what the brief still has to say.

stack.description: The stack in one line, for example: Next.js and TypeScript, SQLite, hosted on Vercel.

title.description: The ADR's title, for example: Next.js and SQLite for the first version.

adr.description: The ADR body in Markdown: context, options considered, decision, consequences. Without the title line.

setup.description: Commands run once in each new worktree. They must work on a repository that has no code yet.

check.description: Lint, build and test, run before any model review. They may assume the first item has scaffolded the project.
